fields.name: full_name_of_deceased
fields.description: The full name of the deceased individual.

fields.name: usaa_number_of_deceased
fields.description: The unique USAA identification number assigned to the deceased.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.description: The birth date of the deceased.

fields.name: contract_numbers
fields.description: The policy contract numbers associated with the deceased.

fields.name: date_of_death
fields.description: The date of death of the policyholder.

fields.name: cause_of_death
fields.description: The cause of death as stated on the claim form.

fields.name: manner_of_death
fields.description: The classified manner of death: Natural, Suicide, Accident, Homicide, Unknown, or Other.

fields.name: signature_of_beneficiary
fields.description: The name of the beneficiary signing the claim form.

fields.name: date_of_signature
fields.description: The date the beneficiary signed the claimant's statement.

fields.name: beneficiary_date_of_birth
fields.description: The birth date of the beneficiary.

fields.name: beneficiary_ssn_or_tin
fields.description: The Social Security Number or Tax Identification Number of the beneficiary.

fields.name: beneficiary_name
fields.description: The full name of the beneficiary or authorized representative.

fields.name: citizenship_status
fields.description: The citizenship status of the beneficiary (U.S. Citizen, Resident Alien, Non-Resident Alien).

fields.name: beneficiary_mailing_street_address
fields.description: The mailing street address of the beneficiary.

fields.name: beneficiary_mailing_city
fields.description: The city of the beneficiary's mailing address.

fields.name: beneficiary_mailing_state
fields.description: The state of the beneficiary's mailing address.

fields.name: beneficiary_mailing_zip_code
fields.description: The ZIP code of the beneficiary's mailing address.

fields.name: beneficiary_phone_number
fields.description: The phone number of the beneficiary.

fields.name: beneficiary_physical_street_address
fields.description: The physical street address of the beneficiary.

fields.name: beneficiary_physical_city
fields.description: The city of the beneficiary's physical address.

fields.name: beneficiary_physical_state
fields.description: The state of the beneficiary's physical address.

fields.name: beneficiary_physical_zip_code
fields.description: The ZIP code of the beneficiary's physical address.

fields.name: mailing_address_same_as_physical
fields.description: Indicates if the mailing address is the same as the physical address (Yes or No).

document.document_description: A claimant's statement is a formal document submitted to an insurance company to request the disbursement of benefits following the death of a policyholder. It includes details about the deceased, the beneficiary, and relevant claim information.
